video.title: Morning Prayer for Peace & Protection | Start Your Day With God 🙏🏽
video.description:
Start your morning in the peaceful presence of God. 🙏🏽❤️

This morning prayer for peace, protection, guidance, and strength is a gentle reminder that you do not have to face today alone. Heavenly Father is watching over you, even while you sleep. He never sleeps, never abandons you, and never stops caring for you.

As you listen to this powerful morning prayer, surrender your worries, plans, family, work, relationships, and unanswered prayers to God. Ask Him to guide your steps, protect you from danger, give you wisdom, strengthen your heart, and fill your day with His peace.
 #MorningPrayer #MorningPrayerForPeace #PrayerForProtection #DailyPrayer #PrayerForToday #StartYourDayWithGod #ChristianPrayer #PowerfulMorningPrayer #PrayerForStrength #GodsProtection #PeacefulPrayer #PrayerBeforeWork #Jesus #God #faith

transcript.text: Heavenly Father as this new morning begins
I come into your presence with a grateful heart
thank you for the gift of life
for the breath in my lungs
and for the opportunity to see another day
thank you for keeping me through the night
and carrying me through every moment
I could not see or understand
Heavenly Father you are the eternal God
the one who never sleeps and never grows weary
while I rested you watched over me
while I was unaware your eyes remained upon me
thank you for being my refuge
my covering and my constant protector
I surrender this day completely into your hands
I surrender my plans my expectations
my worries my conversations
and everything I cannot control
go before me Lord
order my steps and guide me in the way I should go
give me wisdom for every decision
patience for every situation
and Grace for every person I encounter
when I am tempted to worry about what lies ahead
remind me that you are already there
father quiet every anxious thought within me
let your peace settle over my heart like still waters
help me not to carry yesterday's burdens into today
give me the Grace to leave what I cannot change
in your hands
and the courage to trust you with what I cannot yet see
I choose to trust you
even when I do not have all the answers
I will trust you
even when the path is unclear
I will trust your direction
even when things do not happen according to my timing
help me remember that your timing is never careless
heavenly father let me rest in the assurance
that I am not walking through this day alone
your presence goes before me
your hand remains upon me and your love surrounds me
let my heart remain calm
my spirit remain sensitive to your voice
and my mind remain anchored in you
and as I step into this new day
Lord help me to remember that whatever this day brings
you will be with me through it all
father when the day becomes busy
help me not to lose the stillness
I have found in your presence
when there are many voices around me
help me recognize your voice above them all
if something unexpected happens today
give me Grace to respond with wisdom instead of fear
if a door closes
remind me that you are still leading me
if something takes longer than I expected
teach me patience and if an opportunity comes my way
give me discernment to know whether it is truly from you
Heavenly Father protect my mind from unnecessary worry
protect my heart from bitterness comparison
disappointment and fear
guard my words so that I do not speak out of anger
let my actions reflect kindness
patience and love
please watch over my family and everyone I love
keep them safe wherever they may be
cover their homes their journeys
their work and everything concerning them
where there is trouble bring peace
where there is weakness bring strength
where there is uncertainty
bring clarity Lord
I also bring before you the things I have been praying about quietly
the desires I have not spoken about
the questions I am still waiting for answers to
and the dreams I am afraid may never happen
you know them all
help me not to become discouraged while I wait
teach me to trust your process without losing hope
remind me that silence does not mean you have forgotten me
and waiting does not mean you have abandoned me
father give me peace about the things I cannot control
help me release the need to know exactly how everything
